a.lede: Multiple threat actors are abusing GSocket, a legitimate open-source remote access tool, to maintain access to Linux servers even after patching the vulnerabilities exploited to gain initial access. [...]
a.title: Hackers plant GSocket on Linux servers for persistent access

b.lede: A critical authentication bypass vulnerability in Xen Orchestra is being actively exploited in attacks that could grant administrator privileges and allow takeover of XCP-ng virtualization hosts. [...]
b.title: Critical Xen Orchestra auth bypass flaw exploited to hijack VM servers
